title.zh: Qwen4-Max 正式发布：原生视觉与百万上下文
title.en: Qwen4-Max generally available: native vision and 1M context

summary.zh: 通义宣布 Qwen4-Max 正式上线：2.4T MoE、每 token 激活 71B，原生视觉与 100 万 token 上下文。官方称 Work360 单任务平均成本从 $4.43 降到 $1.67。Qoder 提供 Day-0 支持，并把选择器里的 Preview 升级为正式版；同日也登陆 OpenCode Go 等渠道。11 月 12 日已报道过 Preview，这条是正式版与分发，不是首次亮相。Qoder 与 OpenCode 的接入记为相关产品，不另立成三次发布。
summary.en: Qwen announced that Qwen4-Max is generally available: a 2.4T mixture-of-experts model with 71B parameters active per token, native vision, and a 1M-token context. The official Work360 figure puts average cost per task at $1.67, down from $4.43. Qoder offered day-0 support and upgraded the picker from Preview to the release; the same day it also reached channels such as OpenCode Go. Preview was already covered on 12 November, so this leaf is the general release and distribution, not a first appearance. Qoder and OpenCode access are related products, not three separate launches.

brief.zh: 通义宣布 Qwen4-Max 正式上线：2.4T MoE、每 token 激活 71B，原生视觉与 100 万 token 上下文。Qoder 与 OpenCode Go 同日提供正式版。
brief.en: Qwen4-Max is generally available: 2.4T MoE, 71B active per token, native vision, and a 1M context. Qoder and OpenCode Go carried it the same day.

why.zh: 这是该窗口最大的模型发布。应写成 Preview 升级为正式版并开始更广分发，不要写成首次亮相；正式版与 Preview 的观感争议应并列，不要只抄官方榜单。
why.en: The largest model launch in this window. Write it as Preview becoming the general release and gaining wider distribution, not as a first appearance. Keep the disagreement about how the release feels versus Preview next to the official numbers.
